items.t: Hive Digital CEO says its five-year-old Nvidia GPUs still produce cash flow
items.sum: Hive CEO Aydin Kilic says Nvidia chips bought in 2021 still generate cash, challenging Wall Street’s view that GPUs lose all value.

items.t: HIVE Digital Technologies (TSX:HIVE) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Lower Targets
items.sum: The consensus fair value estimate for HIVE Digital Technologies has been cut from CA$8.48 to CA$6.00, signaling a reset in how analysts are framing potential upside. Recent research links this step down in price targets to higher modeled discount rates, financing and construction concerns, and questions around the timing of the AI cloud ramp, even as signed GPU contracts and Bitcoin mining funded

items.t: Cipher Digital Hovers Near Flatline After Anthropic's $83 IPO Pricing
items.sum: Cipher Digital is hovering near the flatline Thursday after Anthropic's IPO priced at $83 per share, lifting AI cloud services peers.

items.t: Nvidia falls 49 spots on the Roundtable 100 following CEO's exit
items.sum: HIVE Digital executive chairman Frank Holmes says Nvidia’s leadership transition could matter more to investors than the personal scandal.

items.t: Bullish shares are trading lower after Rosenblatt downgraded its rating on the stock from Buy to Neutral.
